title: AWS AppSync to Amazon DynamoDB
description: Create an AWS AppSync API endpoint with a resolver to Amazon DynamoDB

introBox.headline: How it works
text: The SAM template deploys an AppSync API, a DynamoDB table, a GraphQL schema and multiple resolvers to the DynamoDB table.

testing.headline: Testing
text: 1. Once the application is deployed, open the AppSync console at https://us-west-2.console.aws.amazon.com/appsync/home ensuring you are in the same region that the API was deployed to.
2. See the repo for additional testing notes.

cleanup.headline: Cleanup
text: 2. Confirm the stack has been deleted: aws cloudformation list-stacks --query "StackSummaries[?contains(StackName,'STACK_NAME')].StackStatus"
